name: Dreary Village, Crossroads
desc1: This appears to be a small town nestled in the centre of the valley.
desc2: It presents a disheartening sight, even vaguely disturbing, as it is
desc3: constructed largely of grey stone and charcoal-coloured wood. Torches
desc4: set in the sides of the buildings provide the only light. A large
desc5: wooden gallows stands in the centre of the square here, the rope
desc6: swinging slightly in the breeze. The main path continues to the east
desc7: and west, with smaller streets to the north and south.
